title: Hero Intro (JD-style reference)
story: A 35-second mass hero intro: darkness, a slow tease, then the hero walks in on a heavy dark groove that keeps getting bigger until a three-hit ending.
script:
# Hero Intro: outline (written before the music)

**Reference (30 Oct 14:27, Jithesh: 'I need a track like this'):** 'Master - JD Intro Bgm', 35 s. Measured: ~99 BPM, E minor with a raised 7th (D#), very bass-heavy (sub 28%, bass 37%, only 7% above 2 kHz), 808-style sustained sub 47% of the time, a big hit every 2 beats (1.2 s), 4-bar hook (9.6 s), stepwise lead with a wide 2.5-octave range, quiet first 2 s then full on, one brightness sweep at 21 s, dynamic (crest 15 dB). We copy the numbers and feel, never the melody.

| Time | Scene | Music |
|---|---|---|
| 0-2 s | Black, smoke, a silhouette. | Deep low drone and a reversed swell; quiet. |
| 2-12 s | He steps forward, slow motion. | Slam in: heavy 808 sub, a dark processed stab every 2 beats, mridangam under it; the new 4-bar hook on a dark synth lead. |
| 12-21 s | Close-ups, the crowd turns. | Hook again, louder; male wordless chant answers it; veena-style plucked line as a second layer. |
| 21-22 s | He looks up. | One rising sweep and a short stop. |
| 22-32 s | Full mass walk. | Peak: hook at its biggest an octave up, choir chant, drums doubled, brass-like synth stabs. |
| 32-35 s | Title card. | Korvai ending: three slamming hits and a final deep boom. |

**Melody:** E harmonic minor (E F# G A B C D#), raga-shaped bends and slides, new hook E G A B A G F# D# E.

brief.notes: Jithesh 30 Oct 14:27 uploaded 'Master - JD Intro Bgm.mp3' and asked for a track like it. Measured with music/tools/analyze.py + deep.py (numbers in script). Built on the hero rules: electronic leads, one Carnatic instrument as 2nd/3rd layer, steady sub (no pumping), 4-bar theme repeated bigger, korvai ending. 2 takes; we pick.

prompt: A dark, heavy, swaggering modern South Indian mass hero introduction score, 35 seconds, built for a slow-motion hero entry. Electronic and bass-led: a deep, sustained 808 sub-bass that holds long notes, dark processed synth stabs hitting every two beats, gritty distorted textures and unique processed sound design. Very bass-heavy and dark in tone, little high end. One steady tempo, 99 BPM, in E minor with a raised seventh (E F# G A B C D#). ONE original, menacing 4-bar hook (about 10 seconds long) runs through the whole track: E G A B, A G F# D# E, played on a dark synth lead with raga-style bends and slides, coming back bigger every time and climbing an octave at the peak. Written the way today's South Indian film composers score a mass hero entry: swagger, stop-and-slam full-band hits, a male wordless chant answering the hook, a korvai-style ending. Electronic leads; a real mridangam and a plucked veena are the second layer, played close, dry and natural, no heavy echo, not chopped. 0-2 s: quiet, a low drone and a reversed swell. 2-12 s: slam in with the 808 sub, the stabs every two beats and mridangam; the synth lead plays the hook. 12-21 s: the hook again, louder; a deep male wordless chant answers each phrase; the veena plucks a counter-line. 21-22 s: one rising sweep and a half-second stop. 22-32 s: the peak: the hook an octave higher, full male choir chant, doubled drums, brass-like synth stabs. 32-35 s: three slamming full-band hits and a final deep boom that rings out. No soft long intro, no fade-out, no EDM drop, no side-chain pumping, no white-noise risers, no lyrics.
